description: The proposed development comprises Ground floor rear extensions with associated doors, windows and rooflights. Loft conversion with rear dormer. Installation of French doors with balconettes at first and second floor levels to the rear. Enlarged ground floor entrance hall and re-positioned front door to match neighbouring property. First floor infill extensions to the front with new casement window to match existing. Conservation-style rooflights in locations as indicated. General internal alterations to modernise the property.
decision_conditions:
REASONABLE EXCEPTION STATEMENT (RES)

Fire Safety Strategy (which also incorporates requirements of the evacuation lift guidance where including a lift).

All developments
The London Plan 2021 - Policy D12 (A) and D5 and D5 draft_guidance_sheet _d5_b5_evacuation_lifts_070720_web.pdf (london.gov.uk)

London Plan policy D12 requires the submission of a Fire Safety Strategy on all planning applications.  The Fire Safety Strategy should be presented as a standalone document with a clear structure that addresses the criteria set out in London Plan Policy D12 part A.  The submitted drawings should address the requirements set out at paragraphs 3.12.3 and 3.12.4 of the London Plan. Where the applicant considers parts of or the whole policy do not apply, this should be justified in a Reasonable Exception Statement (RES).  Draft guidance on Fire Safety Strategies is available at:
https://www.london.gov.uk/what-we-do/planning/implementing-london-plan/london-plan-guidance-and-spgs/draft-fire-safety-guidance-pre-consultation-information

Where the proposal includes a lift, the applicant should address the requirements of London Plan policy D5 within their Fire Safety Statement.

https://richmond.gov.uk/media/18491/local_validation_checklist_for_all_applications.pdf
